propositions: Current CLI, library, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points independently resolve overlapping environment/files/cwd state without a single immutable, non-secret configuration authority per operation.

An immutable OperationSnapshot must contain validated non-secret effective values, explicit source-kind provenance, selected repository root, and envelope version; it must exclude live auth objects, secret wrappers/values, provider clients, source-file paths, and subprocess environments.

Composition precedence is explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, with repository root selected as explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT > Git top-level/current directory.

Shadow mode is enabled by default via REBAR_OPERATION_SHADOW_SNAPSHOT and must preserve current behavior; when disabled or any snapshot assembly/serialization/fingerprint/diagnostic failure occurs, the untouched authoritative operation continues with a redacted warning.

Representative ordinary ticket/store, LLM-gate, and reconcile operations through CLI, Python, MCP, and direct reconciler must produce identical snapshot values, source kinds, root, version, and fingerprint from the same five-layer inputs.
Malformed selected operation config raises typed config errors before lock/network/write effects, and snapshot construction does not alter stored ticket/bridge formats or persist snapshots.
